abstract: We analyze how a regulator can learn about the \textit{aggregate} health of banks by asking \textit{individual} banks to understand and communicate risks. Focused learning (banks report on the same risks) disciplines banks, yielding higher quality information. Broad learning (reporting on different risks) yields better coverage of information. The information gain from either approach is undermined by banks reducing their exposure to designated risks, resulting in correlated risk exposures and regulatory blind spots. Having each bank report on all risks appears to combine the benefits of focused and broad learning -- but instead increases strategic complementarities across banks and weakens discipline.
abstract_zh: 我们分析监管者如何通过要求个别银行理解和沟通风险，来了解银行的总体健康状况。聚焦式学习（银行报告相同的风险）对银行形成约束，产生更高质量的信息。广泛式学习（报告不同的风险）则能提供更全面的信息覆盖。然而，这两种方式带来的信息增益都会因银行减少对指定风险的敞口而受损，导致风险敞口相关化及监管盲区。让每家银行报告所有风险看似结合了聚焦式与广泛式学习的优势——但实际上却加剧了银行间的战略互补性，削弱了约束力。
title: Broad and focused learning
title_zh: DP21847 广泛学习与聚焦学习

abstract: We develop a model of bias and information loss in supervisory communication and apply it to evaluate a policy reform that delegated supervisory decision-making authority over a subset of bank branches to a lower level. Affected branches become 57-80\% more likely to face supervisory intervention, implying substantial efficiency gains arising from improved detection of banking misconduct and more accurate assessments of its severity. The evidence is inconsistent with alternative explanations, including increased supervisory stringency or greater risk-taking by banks. Our analysis highlights decentralization benefits within supervisory hierarchies specifically, and speaks to the optimal organizational design for fraud detection more broadly.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个关于监管沟通中偏见与信息损失的模型，并将其应用于评估一项政策改革，该改革将部分银行分支机构的监管决策权下放至较低层级。受影响的分支机构面临监管干预的可能性增加了57%-80%，这表明通过提高对银行不当行为的检测能力及其严重性评估的准确性，带来了显著的效率提升。证据与替代解释不符，包括监管严格性增强或银行风险承担增加。我们的分析特别强调了监管层级内部权力下放的益处，并更广泛地涉及欺诈检测的最优组织设计。
title: Subordinates in Charge: Does Delegation Improve Bank Supervision?
title_zh: 下属掌权：授权能否改善银行监管？

abstract: This article provides an overview of the literature on financial literacy. It covers the initial measurement that created the Big Three questions and measures of personal finance knowledge featuring 28 questions. It shows that levels of financial literacy are low and have not been improving over time. This is true not only in the United States but also in countries worldwide. These findings matter because financial literacy is conducive to savvy financial behaviors, from holding precautionary savings to planning for retirement to many other financial decisions. Financial education programs have grown exponentially over time, providing important insights into their cost-effectiveness. Personal finance courses have been added to high school and college curricula, and the evidence indicates that they are useful initiatives to improve financial knowledge and downstream behavior.
abstract_zh: 本文对金融素养相关文献进行了综述。文章涵盖了最初构建“三大问题”的测量方法，以及包含28个问题的个人财务知识测量指标。研究表明，金融素养水平普遍较低，且随时间推移并未得到改善。这一现象不仅存在于美国，也见于全球各国。这些发现之所以重要，是因为金融素养有助于促进明智的财务行为，从持有预防性储蓄到规划退休，乃至其他诸多财务决策。金融教育项目数量呈指数级增长，为其成本效益提供了重要见解。个人理财课程已被纳入高中和大学课程体系，证据表明，这些举措在提升金融知识及后续行为方面颇具成效。
title: Improving Financial Literacy: From Corporate Finance to Personal Finance
title_zh: DP21845 提升金融素养：从公司金融到个人金融

abstract: Economic historians have long placed culture at the centre of the rise of the West, but have lacked a measure of culture spanning the emergence of modern growth. Using 23,064 historical books, this column constructs an ‘innovation wedge’ that separates the values texts endorse from the social arrangements they merely depict. The wedge falls by 51% between 1000 and 1920. In a calibrated growth model, that decline accounts for about two-thirds of the first sustained acceleration in productivity growth between 1500 and 1700.
abstract_zh: 经济史学家长期以来将文化置于西方崛起之核心，但一直缺乏一种能够跨越现代增长兴起的文化度量。本文利用23,064本历史书籍，构建了一个“创新楔子”，用以区分文本所推崇的价值观与仅作为描绘对象的社会安排。该楔子在1000年至1920年间下降了51%。在一个校准的增长模型中，这一下降解释了1500年至1700年间生产率增长首次持续加速的大约三分之二。
title: Nine centuries of cultural change and the productivity of ideas
title_zh: 九个世纪的文化变迁与思想生产力

abstract: Many public institutions are now experimenting with AI tools to support surveillance, supervision, and policy analysis, raising questions about which analytical tasks can be delegated to machines and which still require expert judgement. Comparing several GPT models with IMF economists’ assessments of Article IV staff reports, this column shows that today’s best models perform well on structured, factual tasks but remain less reliable on nuanced rating questions, where human judgement still matters.
abstract_zh: 许多公共机构正尝试运用人工智能工具来辅助监控、监管及政策分析，这引发了关于哪些分析任务可交由机器处理、哪些仍需专家判断的疑问。通过对比多种GPT模型与国际货币基金组织经济学家对第四条磋商工作人员报告的评估，本专栏指出，当前最先进的模型在结构化、事实性任务上表现出色，但在涉及细微差别的评级问题上仍不够可靠，这些领域人类的判断依然至关重要。
title: Macrofinance meets AI: Evaluating alignment between LLMs and economists
title_zh: 宏观金融遇上人工智能：评估大语言模型与经济学家之间的一致性
